While everyday families struggle under staggering inequality, the political establishment scrambles to defend the ultra-rich and fossil fuel extractors who are hoarding our collective wealth. Furthermore, the opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran, showing a complete surrender to hawkish militarism and right-wing authoritarianism. This is why we need radical institutional reform, not business as usual that only serves the powerful elites.
